notes.title: 👽 Glitch Blaster's Waifu 👽
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40743330/dd698bd32454144b1c01ea1167724fc4c3467436.gif[/img]

Glitch Blaster's Waifu finally has a Steam page!

From our friends, Osando Studio, creators of two of past releases Hot Tentacles Shooter and Double Shit Gals.

Glitch Blaster's Waifu, is retro-style shoot 'em up adventure!

As an intrepid hacker, you find yourself pitted against a malevolent AI that has kidnapped innocent girls.

Don't wait more and wishlist now!

The game will be releasing sometime Q2 2024!

👽👽👽

notes.title: Furry Hentai Tangram is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40743330/7c5c4c6de3eceabfb40ab013f575c78c2d60ac25.jpg[/img]

In Furry Hentai Tangram, you’ll solve tangram puzzles while enjoying beautiful art.

To clear a level you need to place all the available pieces on the given pattern. But they can't overlap!

Explore a 3D hallway full of cute paintings, and build your gallery with images from the tangram puzzles you’ve completed.

Experience the timeless joy of 65 different tangram puzzles.

FEATURES
[list]
[*] Tangram puzzle gameplay
[*] 65 different levels
[*] 26 different images to unlock
[*] Beautiful images of lovely furry girls
[*] Gallery mode
[*] Includes "Streamer mode" with censored images
[/list]

[b]20% launch discounted (ending December 2nd)[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2121630/Furry_Hentai_Tangram/
